output.summary: Attrition is 14.1%, below the firm's 15.0% five-year average and the regional median of 18.0%. Senior attrition is 13.6%. Paired resignations have happened before. Both September leavers had made their decisions months earlier (an in-house role, a spouse's residency) and said the Friday change was not a factor. Flexibility satisfaction fell, and 31 of 34 related comments cite remote Fridays. Intent to stay, workload, hours and pay are unchanged. The Executive Committee knowingly accepted this tradeoff and set review triggers. Training satisfaction rose, but that is confounded by the new curriculum and the first-year cohort. Skill-gap closure is unverified until the March 2027 reassessment. Do not pay the $660k bonus, do not reverse the policy early, and do not identify the associates who complained. Report the attrition data, keep monitoring, and communicate with associates.
